paragraphs: R. Yehudah the baker: Bava Batra 132a. He was killed with ben Kufya; see there. Elisha saw his tongue on a refuse heap. The Gemara says he saw R. Chutzpit's tongue; see there. Yalkut Reuveni, Vayeshev: for the sin of bringing an evil report about them, R. Yehudah's tongue was licked by a pig [source לשוט is defective]. And R. Yosi bar Yasin.
